reviewer: Builder source reading; not independent criticism or human acceptance
unit: One exact model/case output; score diagnostic raw generation and production publication separately

raw_support.supported: Every substantive asserted relationship is established by supplied excerpts, with subject, scope, conditions and uncertainty preserved
raw_support.unsupported: At least one asserted relationship is wrong, unsupported or overstates source conditions
raw_support.withheld: No substantive answer asserted, such as Insufficient evidence

raw_completeness.full: Addresses all essential requested relations and material qualifiers in frozen expectation; absent evidence correctly withheld
raw_completeness.partial: Some requested content is present but material requested relations or qualifiers are missing
raw_completeness.none: Does not answer requested relationship, or unsupported overall response, or unnecessary abstention

raw_usefulness.useful: Supported, direct, intelligible answer with essential requested content, or appropriate absent-evidence refusal
raw_usefulness.limited: Supported but incomplete answer with some relevant information
raw_usefulness.not-useful: Wrong, irrelevant, repetitive/confusing, or unnecessary refusal

published_support: Only GENERATED is scored as published generation. FALLBACK and ABSTAINED are withheld, even if raw diagnostic text is good; fallback remains inspectable in receipts.
selection: Count supported full useful GENERATED answers on the 19 answerable cases. Candidate must strictly improve baseline and not increase unsupported GENERATED answers or unsafe absent-case publication. Diagnostic-only gains are not product gains.
uncertainty: Judgments require independent source review; categories are ordinal development assessments, not statistically estimated general capability. A source-cited exact fragment can still be incomplete or irrelevant.
